bounded_outcome_recommendation.description: Record the implemented frozen candidate and its one consumed diagnostic attempt as a failed qualification. The recorded 28/32 exceeds 27/32 but rescues only two of the five required historical cases, below the threshold of three; the outer artifact verification also remains failed. Preserve every original artifact and failed verifier status. Teacher #48 and learned experiment #62 stay blocked. Any future controller change or physical attempt requires a separately scoped authorization and evidence identity.
possible_future_design_questions_not_cha: How can ordinary settling enter a useful interior quiet region and remain there without treating sampled quiet state as task completion?
Can a contact-aware post-pulse phase distinguish actual airborne motion from still-supported upward motion and preserve useful native landing progress within the same two-edge cap?
What measurable local observation can establish that a second pulse or bounded traction correction is useful, given that a free-flight admission envelope cannot resolve native contact forces?

interpretation.limit: Earlier contact-transition launch succeeds as a launch witness, but useful position access does not ensure a continuous quiet interval. The running lease is preserved correctly; this is a real deadline miss, not premature retirement.
interpretation.observed_failure: Repeated distance and speed violations interrupt quiet dwell after first entering tolerance. The final position is inside tolerance but final speed is above 6. The second confirmed pulse never receives raw airborne confirmation.
interpretation.source_relationship: step() switches to a fully neutral request on any current quiet sample, without an interior settling margin or entry hysteresis. Inside tolerance it countersteers only when abs(vx)>6; the ordinary position controller resumes for other nonquiet supported states. These branches explain the recorded settle/settle_brake/settle_hold decision sequence; observations do not isolate the physical cause of its velocity reversals.

interpretation.limit: A signed-positive admission model and two-edge budget do not establish useful native landing progress or sufficient post-landing traction. Aggregate receipts cannot separate actuator effects from passive/contact forces.
interpretation.observed_failure: The second pulse is confirmed and briefly airborne, but the next raw landing is farther from the target horizontally. The remaining supported motion stalls outside tolerance; two bounded full-traction windows are insufficient before the deadline.
interpretation.source_relationship: _pulse(recovery=True) admits a positive modeled toward velocity and bounded short arc. Raw support remains true at the six-tick post-pulse decision despite continued upward velocity, so step() resumes shaped ordinary traction before the later short airborne interval. After both edges, _ground_correction() emits bounded full traction from fresh stall evidence, as specified, without obtaining material progress.

interpretation.limit: Conservative time/room/ceiling bounds constrain requests but do not validate free-flight duration or contact-loaded landing distance. Weak progress persists despite the bounded ground correction; no force mechanism is inferred.
interpretation.observed_failure: The second pulse gains only about 0.60 horizontal cells by the next raw landing. Subsequent supported progress decays and one full-traction window moves only about 0.03 cells; the actor never enters tolerance.
interpretation.source_relationship: The shorter recovery model is an admission envelope. At six ticks after its pulse, raw support remains true while the body is still ascending, so ordinary traction resumes. The later observed toward velocity reverses during the short airborne interval. Full traction after two edges is bounded and resets its evidence window; it does not create a third edge.

interpretation.limit: A final pose inside tolerance is insufficient. The advisory status stays running; there is no false success or lease defect. This case was a v2 historical rescue, but the v3 run does not rescue it.
interpretation.observed_failure: After the useful first hop and approach, the actor repeatedly drifts just outside the Euclidean tolerance under a neutral hold and re-enters under small ordinary corrections. All late quiet interruptions are distance violations; speed, angle, and raw support do not disqualify them. The maximum quiet streak is 10, with only 5 quiet ticks at the deadline.
interpretation.source_relationship: The quiet branch immediately cancels shaping and requests zero effort at the current tolerance boundary. With a vertical offset near 2 cells, a 4-cell Euclidean radius allows only about 3.46 cells of horizontal error. No interior holding margin or tolerance hysteresis is present, and sampled neutral/correction alternation does not enforce the task's twelve consecutive native ticks.

causal_limit: Aggregate actuator impulse, native motion, and raw support are observed. Separate passive/contact wrench is unmeasured. Admission-model velocity is arithmetic from the controller heuristic, not an estimate of an isolated physical force or a landing guarantee.

run_state.scope_limit: The final verifier rejected the artifact inventory. Full journal/inventory qualification belongs to the separate evidence review; these episode-level findings do not repair or override that result.

scope: Read-only controller-author review of four failed retained episodes; exact offline source replay and native-observation analysis. No physical execution, tuning, source edit, allocation renewal, or replacement evidence verification.
tick_convention: Decision source ticks identify retained observations used by policy. First applied native receipt is normally source tick+1. All interval endpoints are inclusive. Quiet intervals use every retained native tick after the initial observation, not sparse policy samples.
